prompt: Why is the standby in another region usually asynchronous?

choices.text: Patroni forbids synchronous standbys far away
choices.why: It allows them; the latency forbids them.

choices.text: Every commit would wait a long round trip
choices.why: Right: a tenth of a second or more per commit between continents.
